caseName: South-Central Timber Development, Inc. v. LeResche

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari *1035granted, ante, p. 890.] Motion of Pacific Rim Trade Association et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
